speaker: Doctor
text: I will begin by asking a few key questions to understand the progression of your gait and limb ataxia. How long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and have they been steadily worsening? Have you noticed any changes in your vision, hand dexterity, or bladder control?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Please specify the exact duration of your symptoms and whether the clumsiness has progressed to one specific limb or affects both sides equally. Additionally, have you noticed any recent vision changes, numbness, or loss of coordination when swallowing?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.
